=== _Host.cshtml head ===
﻿@page "/"
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web
@namespace Bovis.Web.Pages
@addTagHelper *, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.TagHelpers

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <base href="~/" />
    <!--
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css" />
    -->
    <link href="libraries/bootstrap/5.3.3/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="libraries/bootstrap/5.3.3/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <link href="libraries/bootstrap-icons/1.12.1/bootstrap-icons.css" rel="stylesheet">

    <link href=@Bovis.Web.Util.ViewUtils.CacheBust("css/site.css") rel="stylesheet" />
    <link href=@Bovis.Web.Util.ViewUtils.CacheBust("Bovis.Web.styles.css") rel="stylesheet" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href=@Bovis.Web.Util.ViewUtils.CacheBust("favicon.png") />
    <component type="typeof(HeadOutlet)" render-mode="ServerPrerendered" />
    <script>
        window.BovisShowAlert = function(message) {
        alert(message);
        }
    </script>
</head>
<body>
    <component type="typeof(App)" render-mode="ServerPrerendered" />
